verdict.rationale: Remote documents its own time-off request handling: employees can submit time-off requests through the official MCP server, and the CLI can act on (approve or decline) time-off requests. This covers only the approvals slice of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows defining PTO policies, configuring accruals, or time off flowing automatically into payroll. Missing for 10: PTO policy definition, accrual rules, automatic payroll application of approved leave, independent corroboration.
